Name: Slovene learner corpus KOST 2.0
Description:
This corpus of Slovene as a foreign language KOST (Korpus slovenščine kot tujega jezika) contains 8,347 texts (just over 1.3 million words) written by adult speakers for whom Slovene is not their first language. 
Most of the authors of these texts speak Serbian, Bosnian and Macedonian as their first language, but texts by speakers of other languages are also included. The authors are at different proficiency levels in Slovene, from beginners to advanced. 
The corpus is available for download from the Slovenian repository CLARIN.SI and can be queried through noSketchEngine and KonText concordancers.
Annotation: annotated with rich author and text metadata
